parameters.query: SELECT h.id, h.original_title, h.category, r.summary, r.key_facts, r.verification_status FROM headlines h JOIN research r ON h.id = r.headline_id WHERE h.status = 'researched' AND h.scraped_at >= NOW()::DATE ORDER BY h.published_at DESC;

SELECT h.id, h.original_title, h.category, r.summary, r.key_facts, r.verification_status FROM headlines h JOIN research r ON h.id = r.headline_id WHERE h.status = 'researched' AND h.category = 'world' AND h.scraped_at >= (NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days') ORDER BY h.published_at DESC;
INSERT INTO scripts (id, headline_id, script_type, content, word_count, estimated_duration_seconds, tone, generated_at) VALUES (gen_random_uuid(), $1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, NOW()) RETURNING id;
UPDATE headlines SET status = 'scripted' WHERE id = $1 RETURNING id;
INSERT INTO scripts (id, headline_id, script_type, content, word_count, estimated_duration_seconds, tone, generated_at) VALUES (gen_random_uuid(), NULL, $1, $2, $3, $4, $5, NOW()) RETURNING id;
INSERT INTO logs (workflow, level, message, metadata, created_at) VALUES ('script_generator', 'INFO', 'Script generation completed', $1::jsonb, NOW()) RETURNING id;
